prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Redesign for Pet Selection: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a full-width visual carousel layout displaying pet personalities and high-resolution companion cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion"}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Arrival Checklist Screen: Insert a new desktop arrival checklist screen right before home intro to outline basic controls and screen positioning expectations.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_checklist", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_checklist": {"headline": "Preparing Companion Desktop Controls", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Click pet to chat or open quick actions menu", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [home, redesign] Two-Column Waiting Screen for Pet Initialization: Rebuild the waiting screen into a structured two-column layout split between initialization status and desktop tips.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Setting Up Your Desktop Companion Workspace", "show_time_estimate": true}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Stage Layout Path Selection Redesign: Transform the choose_path screen into a stage layout focused on spotlighting instant adoption vs. custom creation options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Select Your Creation Journey"}}
4: [sign_in, layout] Centered Minimalist Sign-In Layout: Update the sign_in screen to a simple centered layout focusing entirely on clear, fast authentication options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Companion"}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Pet Personality Trait Badges: Add vibrant personality badges to companion options on the pick_friend screen to highlight pet behaviors.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Playful & Interactive", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Interaction Copy Reframing: Rewrite the home_intro headline and body to explicitly explain how to click, drag, and interact with the pet once live on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Live on Your Screen!", "body": "Look for your pet roaming your desktop. Click or right-click anytime to open controls, chat, or access settings."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Estimated Processing Time Banner on Waiting Screen: Add explicit estimated time remaining indicators and real-time generation progress text on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "body": "Preparing graphics and behavioral models. This typically takes 1 to 2 minutes."}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Clear Pathway Story Guidance Copy: Update story screen body copy to clearly explain the difference between instant pre-made pets and custom photo generation.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Companions", "body": "Adopt a ready-to-play companion in seconds, or customize a unique pet using your own photos."}}
9: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Account Saving Micro-Hint: Add micro-copy hint on the adoption certificate screen confirming that pet data is permanently saved to the signed-in account.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "This adoption certificate links your pet permanently to your account."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend layout to a carousel preserves its core job of selecting a pet.
Adding a new checklist screen before home_intro within onboarding is permitted and retains all required steps.
Rebuilding the waiting screen into a two-column layout preserves the initialization status job.
Redesigning choose_path into a stage layout maintains both adoption and custom creation pathways.
Updating sign_in to a centered layout keeps its core authentication job intact.
Adding personality badges to pick_friend options enhances selection without breaking any rules.
Updating copy for home_intro stays inside onboarding and provides clearer interaction instructions.
Adding estimated wait time and real-time generation progress to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.
Updating story copy to introduce pets and outline pathways complies with onboarding rules.
Adding micro-copy to the adoption certificate does not remove required components or violate rules.
